alternate_names: Sri Bala Tripura Sundari Temple, Suryaraopet

history.summary: Prominent Shakti shrine in Kakinada dedicated to Goddess Bala Tripura Sundari, located near Pindala Cheruvu on Jawahar Street, Suryaraopet (pin code 533001). inKakinada lists it as established in 1875 and describes it as one of the oldest and famous temples in Kakinada, with special poojas to Tripura Sundari Ammavaru every Friday. AMBIGUITY FLAG: there are also Bala Tripura Sundari sametha shrines at Jagannaickpur (with Sarveswara Swami) and Repuru (with Visweswara Swamy) - this file documents the standalone Suryaraopet shrine. COORD FLAG: geocoder returned (16.95897, 82.23299) with POI address 'Atchuta Ramayya Street, Ramarao Peta' while listings place it at Suryaraopet near Pindala Cheruvu - adjacent old-city localities, verify locally. CSV STATE FLAG: the CSV state field says 'Kakinada', which is a city, not a state; the correct state is Andhra Pradesh. CSV town 'Kakinada' is correct (Suryaraopet is a locality within Kakinada city). DISTRICT NOTE: Kakinada district (carved from East Godavari in 2022).

name: Sri Bala Tripura Sundari Temple (Kakinada)
town_description: Kakinada is a coastal city in Kakinada district, Andhra Pradesh, on the Bay of Bengal, known for its port, beaches and old temples including the Suryaraopet Bala Tripura Sundari shrine and the Sarpavaram Bhavanarayana temple.

travel.railway: Kakinada Town railway station (~1.5 km per inKakinada)
travel.road: The temple is in central Kakinada near Pindala Cheruvu, reachable by auto and local bus

visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:30 AM - 11:30 AM and 5:00 PM - 8:30 PM per inKakinada/JustDial; promallu gives slight variations (Fri 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 5:00 - 9:00 PM) - verify locally
